evidence.excerpt: Plain-woven CFF (J9-2019066-1 K); PEEK film thickness 70 μm; ethanol used as received.
PEEK films 10 × 15 cm washed with ethanol and dried in a vacuum oven at 60 °C for 4 h; film stacking and vacuum hot pressing.
Standard laboratory atmosphere: 23 °C and 50% relative humidity. The listed 100 KN is not an imposed specimen load.
ASTM D2344; ASTM D7264; ASTM D3039; all mechanical tests repeated at least five times.
SEM Nova NanoSEM 450, platinum-coated samples; C-SAM PVA SAM 300, 30 MHz, deionized water.
0.5 MPa at 340 °C for 10 min; 1.5 MPa at 360 °C for 10 min; then 415 °C and 10 MPa for 60 min.
作者将温度、压力、保温时间改变后性能变化解释为树脂流动、浸渍、缺陷和界面传力变化；未给出独立中介识别。
作者称微小纤维间隙可低于超声检测能力，并将预压改善解释为排气和浸渍的改善。
